newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish live trade stocks end down, defy main mkt.
newsitem.headline: Polish live trade stocks end down, defy main mkt.

text.p: Five stocks ended lower, four were flat and six did not see action in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
Turnover eased slightly to 2.8 million zlotys from Wednesday's 2.9 million.
NFI units were flat at 144 zlotys in a 15.6-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks gained and the main market's index rose 1.6 percent.
